description: This file contains unit tests for the JacksonCborFactory class in the org.eclipse.ditto.json.cbor package. It tests serialization and deserialization of JSON values using CBOR encoding with various input types and configurations.

classes.name: JacksonCborFactoryTest
classes.description: A final class that performs unit testing of the JacksonCborFactory class, verifying serialization/deserialization functionality using parameterized tests.

methods.name: testValue_STRINGS
methods.description: Provides a list of JSON string test values used as parameters for the tests.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes test data and the CBOR factory before each test method.

methods.name: readFromByteArrayWithoutOffset
methods.description: Tests reading a JsonValue from a byte array without any offset.

methods.name: readFromByteArrayWithOffset
methods.description: Tests reading a JsonValue from a subarray with an offset and length.

methods.name: readFromByteBuffer
methods.description: Tests reading a JsonValue from a ByteBuffer.

methods.name: readFromByteBufferWithInaccessibleArray
methods.description: Tests reading from a read-only ByteBuffer, ensuring compatibility when the backing array is inaccessible.

methods.name: toBytebufferWorks
methods.description: Verifies serialization of a JsonValue to a ByteBuffer and compares the result with expected hex string.

methods.name: writeToByteBufferWorks
methods.description: Tests writing a JsonValue to a ByteBuffer and compares the serialized output with expected data.
